posts.author: Arcanis51
posts.body:
Hello!
I made a custom sprite sheet for my characters with 8 frame walking and idle animations and want to use them now in my game.
They are 48x96px sized.
I tried around with galvs plugin which is great but i really dont get galvs scaling in the spritesheeds on his frame animations.
Does someone know an easy to use plugin for MZ where i can just use my 48x96 sprites for 8 frames?

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
Easy to use can be relative. I don't know how can I answer you that. But indeed a combination of two of my plugins will work for you, once you take your time to lear how to use them:
Character Poses for the Idle animation.
Hakuen Studio Character Poses for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Add Idle, Walk, Dash, and Jump poses to characters!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
Character Frames for the 8 frames:
Hakuen Studio Character Frames for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Increase the number of frames for character sprite sheets!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
You can check both plugin help files on the link above before you buy them, to see how they work.
